name: frameworks-drum
description: MCP server for the FRAMEWORKS DRUM — query the living catalog of frameworks, charters, regulations, and articles (aligned to master doctrine v1.4).

tools.name: drum_catalog
tools.description: Return counts and kinds in the drum catalog.

tools.name: drum_search
tools.description: Search the catalog by query (name, kind, jurisdiction, status, binding).

tools.name: drum_get
tools.description: Return one catalog item by id.

tools.name: drum_crosswalk
tools.description: Find items that connect a source and a target (charter to framework, etc.).

honesty.catalog: regenerated by build_catalog.py from estate seed + _mining/
honesty.note: serves the catalog only; no certification, no autonomous claims
